aiResearchSummary.text: Inokyo is focused on enhancing the autonomous retail experience by developing systems for detecting users in autonomous stores through image analysis from tracking cameras. This technology facilitates the creation of virtual shopping carts, streamlining the checkout process. The research aims to make shopping more seamless and efficient by integrating advanced image processing techniques to improve user interaction within autonomous retail environments.
